lines.en: I drag my root and shift along.

lines.zh: 叶子在地上一节一节地过。
lines.en: My leaves pass the ground segment by segment.
I look for a spot at the wood's edge.
Good soil here. I can root.

lines.zh: 我从这棵树底下挪到那棵。
lines.en: I shift from under this tree to that one.
The grass lies down where I pass.
My stalk is thick. I move slowly.

lines.zh: 我抬起一片叶子，探了探。
lines.en: I lift a leaf and probe.

lines.zh: 我的根须在土里换位置。
lines.en: My roots shift their place in the soil.

lines.zh: 这个位置，风把味道吹过来。
lines.en: From here the wind brings smells.

lines.zh: 我张开了口，叶子一节节过去。
lines.en: I open my mouth and my leaves pass forward segment by segment.

lines.zh: 里面有点甜味，会招东西来。
lines.en: Something sweet inside. It draws things.
I turn slowly toward the next spot.

lines.zh: 林子里的东西，都躲着我。
lines.en: Everything in the wood avoids me.
I stand there like a tree.
I've been in this wood before.
There were more flying squirrels then.
Dust on my leaves. I don't shake it.
The wind sets my leaves rustling.

lines.zh: 那声音听着像别的东西。

lines.en: I wait for them to come close.
My leaf spines rise one by one.
You're walking over. But you're no tree.
But you don't look like you fly either.
You can smell that sweetness, can't you.
I may look like a tree, but I can't walk.
One of my leaves is torn off.
I don't cry out. I have no voice.

lines.zh: 我把叶子合上，护住伤口。
lines.en: I close my leaves over the wound.
Anything that comes, I can take.
You hold it out in front.
You hold it out front. Just right.
I'll take the thing, and you with it.
Shut tight. Not a bit escapes.

lines.zh: 你退开的时候，扯断了一片。
lines.en: You tore a leaf getting free.

lines.zh: 我的叶子碰到了你的肩。

lines.en: My root isn't deep, but enough to turn.
My slime sticks to your boot.
You're standing in just the right spot.

lines.zh: 开花的时候才想过这些。
lines.en: I only thought of it when I flowered.
All I do is take things in.

lines.zh: 这一片地方，我一个人守。

lines.en: There's nothing for you here. Go.
I curl a leaf around it.

lines.zh: 我一口吞下去，连名字都不剩。
lines.en: One gulp and not even a name is left.
What's in the leaves. It's moving.
I take it into my belly.
Empty again. Wait for the next.
The sweetness rose. It smells it.
I twist to follow your direction.
My mouth stays pointed at it.

lines.zh: 它还没发觉，叶子已经合上一半。
lines.en: It has not noticed; my leaves are half-closed.

lines.zh: 外面还在挣，里面听不见。
lines.en: It struggles outside. Inside hears nothing.

lines.zh: 叶子上的甜味，盖过别的。
lines.en: The sweetness on my leaves covers everything.

lines.zh: 我拖着根挪过去，一点声音都没有。
lines.en: I drag my roots over without a sound.
I rise out of the soil.
My leaves unfold, one by one.
At the wood's edge the light is right.

lines.zh: 我从芽里撑开第一片叶。
lines.en: I push open my first leaf from the shoot.
The sweetness goes out. Then I wait.

lines.zh: 我的茎很粗，看不出来是活的。
lines.en: My stalk is thick. It looks lifeless.

lines.zh: 火一过，我的叶子就焦了。
lines.en: Fire passed and my leaves scorched.

lines.zh: 我从坡上被推下来，根断了。
lines.en: I was pushed off a slope and my root snapped.
Half of me rots in the water.

lines.zh: 震得我的叶子全翻过来。
lines.en: The blast turned all my leaves over.

lines.zh: 有东西穿过叶子，扎进茎里。
lines.en: Something went through a leaf into the stalk.

lines.zh: 那光让我的叶子卷起来。
lines.en: That light made my leaves curl.

lines.zh: 很久没吃到东西，叶子软了。
lines.en: Nothing eaten for so long. My leaves soften.
Lightning struck and I went black.
A flytrap with no roots still gets hungry.
